title: Library
description: library.v1: a classification library (VIGILANS_SPEC.md section 9; docs/classifier-design.md). The repository ships a synthetic one; a private one in the same format is loaded from outside the tree and never committed. Data only: nothing here is evaluated. Each class states, per feature, the range it expects; the engine turns ranges into soft likelihoods (soft edges, widened by each measurement's own uncertainty) and weighs them against the library's background -- 'none of the above' -- so unclassified is a real answer. Scale features (frequencies, bandwidths, durations, periods) are compared on a log scale. Supersedes library.v0.

background.title: Background
background.description: The span each feature can plausibly take for anything at all. A class's range is evidence only to the extent it is narrower than this.

range.title: Range
range.description: Inclusive, both ends given. `soft`: width of the soft edge, in the feature's unit (on a log scale for scale features, as a fraction: 0.05 is 5 %). `weight`: how much the feature counts within its class, default 1.

parent.description: A broader class this one refines: answers are given at the deepest level the evidence supports.

label.description: A plain noun phrase. The engine adds the hedge ('likely', 'possible'); a label must not carry one of its own.

features.title: Features
features.description: Externals only (rule 2). A class without features is a category: its probability is the sum of its descendants'.

stationary.description: How likely this class is to be staying put, 0..1. Compared with the tracker's stationary-model probability.

on_road.description: How likely this class is to follow roads, 0..1. Compared with the chance-corrected on_road feature from an offline road map (ADR-0014).

on_water.description: How likely this class is to be on water, 0..1. Compared with the on_water feature from an offline water map (ADR-0014).

height_agl_m.description: Height above ground, from the entity's height and an offline terrain grid (ADR-0014). Never used for radio horizon.

source_claims.description: Self-identification categories this class is consistent with (ADR-0006). A claim is weighed, never trusted.

affiliation.title: DeclaredAffiliation
affiliation.description: An affiliation this library declares for the class, with its reasons. Applied only when the class is 'likely'. Absent: the entity stays unknown.

symbol.title: SymbolTemplate
symbol.description: A MIL-STD-2525C letter code with '*' in the identity position; the engine fills in the identity it assessed.
